Package com.sca4d.web.realtime.stomp

Class StompConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.web.realtime.stomp.StompConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation.WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker @Internal public class StompConfiguration extends Object implements org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation.WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer
使用 Spring STOMP 配置 WebSocket 端点、broker 模式和入出站拦截器。
